title: HHT: a personal, local-first travel diary for iOS
description:
HHT is a private, local-first iOS app that works like a continuous household travel survey for one person. It records location in the background, rebuilds each day into visits, trips, modes and trip chains, lets the user correct mistakes in one or two taps, and exports a research-grade dataset (CSV, JSON, GeoJSON, SQLite).

The release contains the SwiftUI app, the platform-independent HHTCore Swift package (storage, stay detection, trip building, mode classification, editing with an audit log, HHTS-style analytics and export), a Python loader and example analysis, and the documentation site.

Documentation: https://zhanchaoyang.com/HHT-app/docs/
